text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, I lost...! She caught me totally 
off guard...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined I'd see a backflip! —In a 
game of hopscotch, no less!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I just got into the groove! I 
thought I'd throw in a little fun, and it 
totally worked out!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kh... Your physical prowess is as 
terrifying as ever. You even landed 
properly on one hand during hopscotch, 
leaving no room for excuses. It's my 
complete defeat...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...All right, it's decided! Starting 
today, I'm practicing backflips!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If I lost at backflips, I'll win with a 
backflip included! Otherwise, it wouldn't 
be a true victory in my contest against 
you!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~~~! That sounds great! Jumping 
together with Ai-senpai sounds like so 
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I've gotta practice too! A 
moonsault, an Arabian double... and a 
double layout with two twists!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm almost able to pull off that 
super difficult flip! You'll do it with me 
too, won't you, Ai-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Yes, of course. After all, I've 
decided to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep at it until I've mastered 
everything. And then, I'll have my revenge 
on you!
